basic_info.description: 2618- 2618A Balboa St. is a rare opportunity to own a luxury 3 bed/2 bath main residence + 2 bed/1 bath additional dwelling unit in the heart of the Richmond District. These residences offer an array of customization, from architectural entryways to custom millwork, providing for a unique living space that is both comfortable & elegant. Both the main residence and ADU offer grand scale great rooms and are a remarkable refuge from the bustling city, boasting large open living/dining areas. The impressive kitchens offer architectural details, an abundance of storage & professional grade Thermador appliances. This property has exclusive access to the lovely landscaped walk-out garden escape complete with a built-in trampoline!
